features.title: Material Procurement
features.body: Site teams request materials without knowing budget availability, and procurement raises POs without checking remaining allocations. By the time accounts reconcile, projects have already blown the material budget. SiteFlow enforces budget availability checks before any order is placed.
bullets: Real-time procurement control with budget availability checks before ordering
Vendor management from RFQ to payment with complete audit trails

features.title: Multi-Site Visibility
features.body: Each site keeps its own inventory register. Site A may have excess cement while Site B faces shortages, with no systematic transfer tracking. SiteFlow shows consolidated stock across all sites and flags redeployable surplus before new orders are placed.
bullets: Multi-site inventory tracking with material transfer and consumption visibility
Stock levels updated automatically as deliveries and issues are recorded

faqs.q: What is construction supply chain management software?
faqs.a: It connects procurement, inventory, vendor management, and payment control so every material decision stays accurate and budget-aligned. Track procurement pipelines, vendor performance, and inventory positions without manual reconciliation or Excel dependency.

faqs.q: How does SiteFlow prevent material procurement beyond project budgets?
faqs.a: Site teams raise material requests mapped to BOQ line items and project budget allocations. Every requisition triggers a configurable approval workflow that enforces budget parameters before a purchase order is generated.

faqs.q: Can SiteFlow track inventory across multiple construction sites at once?
faqs.a: Yes. View consolidated inventory balances across all active project sites from one dashboard, and identify excess stock at completed sites available for redeployment before ordering new materials.

cta.heading: Stop procurement leakage, start real supply chain control
cta.body: SiteFlow links every material request to BOQ budgets, validates deliveries against purchase orders, and matches vendor bills against GRN records automatically.
